sloka: यद्यपि त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रथितम् ते मयद् यशः ।सानुक्रोशो वदान्यः च प्रिय वादी च राघवः ॥२-६१-२॥
transliteration: yadyapi triṣu lokeṣu prathitam te mayad yaśaḥ ।sānukrośo vadānyaḥ ca priya vādī ca rāghavaḥ ॥2-61-2॥

translations.english: Your great fame has spread all over the three worlds. People know you as compassionate, generous and sweetspeaking scion of the Raghus.
